dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Paraneoplastic opsoclonus–ataxia syndrome (opsoclonus–myoclonus syndrome), most likely antibody-mediated, with an occult breast, ovarian, or small-cell lung malignancy not yet identified

Alternative 1: Post-infectious autoimmune opsoclonus–ataxia syndrome

Alternative 2: Anti-NMDA-receptor encephalitis presenting with opsoclonus–ataxia

Alternative 3: Drug- or toxin-induced opsoclonus–ataxia syndrome
